constraints.name: services_image_urls_shape_check
constraints.expression: cardinality("image_urls") <= 10 AND (cardinality("image_urls") = 0 OR (array_ndims("image_urls") = 1 AND array_lower("image_urls", 1) = 1)) AND array_position("image_urls", NULL) IS NULL AND NOT ('' = ANY("image_urls"))

constraints.name: services_image_urls_cover_check
constraints.expression: cardinality("image_urls") = 0 OR ("image_url" IS NOT NULL AND "image_url" = "image_urls"[1])
